long_description:
🍂 Friendsgiving Kirtan & Vegetarian Dinner 🙏 

Kick off Thanksgiving week with an extra-special Kirtan Friendsgiving.

Join us for an extended evening of uplifting music, group meditation, delicious food, and community connection.

This special gathering will be longer than our usual Sunday Kirtan, allowing extra time to enjoy a Thanksgiving meal together and hear a short, meaningful message exploring the connection between the spirit of Thanksgiving and the path of Bhakti Yoga.

Come share in a heartwarming, energizing evening filled with gratitude, connection, and joyful music. 

📅 Event Details

Time: 5:30 PM – 8:30 PM

Location: 

Meet Me on 33rd 

1565 E 3300 S 

Salt Lake City, UT 84106

🎶 What Is Kirtan?

Kirtan is a guided group meditation practice using traditional yoga mantras accompanied by live acoustic music.

It's a relaxing and centering experience that helps quiet the mind, open the heart, and cultivate a deeper sense of peace, connection, and well-being.

No previous meditation or musical experience is necessary. Everyone is welcome.

🥗 Friendsgiving Dinner

Everything for the meal will be provided.

Most dishes will be fully vegan, and all food will be vegetarian. No meat or eggs will be served.

Come hungry and enjoy a delicious meal with our Kirtan community.

❤️ Donations & Contributions

There is no required donation to attend. However, contributions are always appreciated and help support our gatherings and community.

Venmo@Rob-Wallace-35

📱 Can't Join Us in Person?

You can still be part of the experience through our Facebook livestream.

 https://www.facebook.com/meditationsaltlakecity

Join us from the comfort of your home and share in the music, meditation, and community.

Learn More 

www.meditationslc.com

We look forward to sharing this beautiful evening with you!

Namaste 🙏 

🌿 Our Mission

To create a safe & welcoming space for the learning & celebration of Bhakti Yoga through meditation, introspection, & an overall healthy lifestyle
